summary:
This is an interactive 3D space exploration game designed to introduce players to spacecraft engineering, orbital flight, and scientific exploration through engaging gameplay.

Players can assemble their own spacecraft, launch rockets, control flight operations, and complete space missions. The Earth Observation Mission allows players to reach space, observe Earth, capture photographs, transmit scientific data, and attempt a safe return.

Developed using React, JavaScript, and Three.js, the project combines interactive simulation with educational gameplay to make space exploration more accessible and engaging
details:
This is a browser-based 3D space simulation game developed using React, JavaScript, Three.js, and React Three Fiber.

Players begin at Mission Control, where they can prepare missions and assemble spacecraft using different components. During the Earth Observation Mission, players launch their rocket, monitor flight information, adjust throttle and pitch, observe Earth, capture photographs, transmit scientific data, and attempt a safe return.

The project aims to introduce players to spacecraft design, flight control, orbital concepts, and scientific observation through interactive gameplay.
